sections.label: Supply Bill appropriations approval
sections.summary: The Supply Bill seeks legislative approval for appropriations from the consolidated and development funds for the Financial Year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The purpose of the Supply Bill before Members, is to give legislative approval for the appropriations from the consolidated fund and development fund to meet the expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Heads of Expenditure and the sums that may be incurred in aspect of each Head, are shown in the Schedule to the Bill.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: These have been approved by the House in the Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023, as contained in Paper Cmd No 12 of 2022.
